title: I directed Claude to build a hidden-multiplayer mystery game: it starts as a creepy old terminal and turns into a faction war
author: andytechuk
selftext:
I had the idea; Claude (Anthropic’s AI) wrote all the code and text, while I directed, played, broke things and reported back. It’s a single HTML file on [itch.io](http://itch.io) with a Supabase backend for accounts, matchmaking and a shared persistent map.

The premise: you find an old Amstrad-style terminal. Type anything. It accuses you of unauthorised access, and other “users” start typing. I won’t spoil the rest, but it’s built on hidden factions decided by your keystrokes, minesweeper-style deduction, and real players who might be lying to you.

Free, in the browser, works on phone: [https://partyon.itch.io/the-artifact](https://partyon.itch.io/the-artifact)

Happy to answer questions about the workflow: what worked, what broke (a lot), and how much testing it took.
